title: AgentsConflict
description: A subagent that cannot be laid out: a file of its name is in the worktree and Gentry did not lay it out.

file.description: The file, relative to the worktree root with forward slashes.

reason.description: tracked: git of the project tracks the file; foreign: the file is not tracked and Gentry did not lay it out. The list is open.
